
## AI in the code editor
			

<a name="NOTE1"></a>
<a name="NOTE1_1"></a>


## Overview
<a name="overview_ELTTEXTE000123"></a>
WINDEV, WEBDEV and WINDEV Mobile include a series of AI-based features:

- [code comment generation](#NOTE3_1),

- [SCM check-in comment generation](#NOTE4_1).




Note: To use these features, you need an account with access to APIs offered by AI providers. For more details, see [AI services: How to find the key](../Editeurs/2036005.md). 





<a name="NOTE3"></a>
<a name="NOTE3_1"></a>


## Auto-generated procedure documentation
<a name="autogenerated_procedure_documentation_ELTTEXTE000147"></a>
By default, when creating a procedure, you can request the generation of automatic documentation in the procedure header. In this case, the code editor generates a series of structured information the developer must complete. The information entered in the automatic documentation is reused, in particular parameter descriptions. 

The code editor uses AI to automatically generate the content of the documentation: 

1. Go to the code of the desired procedure. 

2. Click ![](https://doc.pcsoft.fr/en-US/images/image.awp?langid=3&name=Documentation_automatique%20-%20HC%20N%B0003%208.gif) in the header of the procedure. 

3. The documentation is then automatically generated. This documentation is editable. 




Remarks: 

- AI never generates exactly the same documentation twice. If you are not happy with the generated documentation, you can press Ctrl + Z (or delete it) and then re-generate it. 

- Automatic documentation is generated in the format specified in the project options (Legacy or Doxygen). 

- Automatic documentation generation options taken into account. For more details, see [Automatic documentation of procedures and methods](../Motscles/1513006.md). 

- To use AI functionalities in WINDEV, WEBDEV and WINDEV Mobile, you need to create an account with the desired AI provider. For more details on OpenAI requirements, see [AI services: How to find the key](../Editeurs/2036005.md). 

- Explanations are generated in the language of the editor: English, French or Spanish.  




<a name="NOTE4"></a>
<a name="NOTE4_1"></a>


## Auto-generated check-in comments
<a name="autogenerated_checkin_comments_ELTTEXTE000171"></a>
When you check in an element back into the SCM, you can enter a brief description of the changes made. 
<br>![](https://doc.pcsoft.fr/en-US/images/image.awp?langid=3&name=P4_Int%E9gration%20dans%20le%20GDS%20-%20HC%20N%B0010.jpg)


The "AI: Generate comment" button makes this an effortless process. Here's how it works: 

- modified, deleted and added code is detected. 

- all added, deleted or modified comments are extracted and sent to the AI. 

- AI then summarizes the changes in about a hundred words. 

- this summary is displayed in the comments area. 




Remarks: 

- AI never generates exactly the same documentation twice. If you are not happy with the generated comment, you can repeat the process. 

- To use AI functionalities in WINDEV, WEBDEV and WINDEV Mobile, you need to create an account with the desired AI provider. For more details on OpenAI requirements, see [AI services: How to find the key](../Editeurs/2036005.md). 

- Explanations are generated in the language of the editor: English, French or Spanish.
